top_news.title: FBI Epstein Emails Show Sarah Ferguson Reached Patel
top_news.summary: Bloomberg News Senior Investigative Reporter writes a weekly newsletter, The FOIA Files. This week's edition show "records, which include emails, spreadsheets and training slides, provide a window into the internal deliberations at the highest levels of government as officials discussed how to review, redact and release the Epstein files." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Lula’s Lead Over Bolsonaro Narrows in Brazil Election Poll
top_news.summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s lead over right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed ahead of Brazil’s October presidential election, according to a new poll published Friday.

top_news.title: Volatile Week for Equity Markets | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Katie Greifeld, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Berkshire Pads Delta, Alphabet Stakes as Abel Taps Cash Pile
top_news.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. increased its holdings in Delta Air Lines Inc. and Google parent Alphabet Inc. as Greg Abel began tapping into the company’s massive cash hoard.

top_news.title: Election Angst Fuels Bruising Week in Brazil Markets
top_news.summary: Brazilian assets posted some of the biggest losses in the world this week amid growing angst over the October presidential election.

top_news.title: EM Currencies Cap Best Streak Since 2024, Stocks Rebound on AI
top_news.summary: Emerging-market assets rose on Friday as a shift in the US interest-rate outlook added to bullish sentiment around artificial intelligence, pushing equities to cap the best week in nearly two months and sending a gauge of currencies on the longest streak of gains since 2024.

top_news.title: US Stocks End Off Record Highs to Mark Third Week of Gains
top_news.summary: US equities ended with gains for a third straight week, their longest winning streak since May, even as they slipped off record highs on Friday after softer consumer data.

top_news.title: Avoid Being Shaken Out Of The Market: Wilson
top_news.summary: Mike Wilson, chief US equity strategist & chief investment officer at Morgan Stanley, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Freshmen Pay Thousands For Sorority Rush Coaches
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how young women rushing sororities have been paying from $3K to $12K for coaches to teach them southern sororities unwritten rules in hopes of getting accepted. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gold Nears $4,400 as Traders Weigh Fed Interest-Rate Path
top_news.summary: Gold edged toward $4,400 an ounce as traders weighed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path after the economy’s main engine showed signs of cooling.
